name: Oundle School and the Cripps Library

layers.essential_history: [[c:Oundle School's buildings are spread through the town centre, so pupils walk between lessons along the old streets.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The school's links with the Grocers' Company go back to Sir William Laxton's will of 1556.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A pupil tells you why Josiah might want the crown: an inn with the Queen's staircase would draw every traveller on the road, and his own inn would be empty.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 40 metres as the crow flies, to the Market Place.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
